name: rfi-nexus-data-mesh-intake
description: Monorepo workspace for RFI Nexus Data Mesh Intake platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "LAYER2,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run dev:layer2" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: bash -c 'test -d .venv || bash scripts/setup.sh; cd apps/backend && ../../.venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000'
scripts.dev:layer2: bash -c 'test -d .venv || bash scripts/setup.sh; cd LAYER2/layer2 && ../../.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001'
